edges: Individual plaintiffs must prove individual causation and damages for strict liability and negligence claims.
If an individual plaintiff receives a favorable verdict, it is subject to appellate review.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Engle defendants are subject to the same legal process as any civil defendant in the Engle class case.
The Engle defendants' property is not arbitrarily deprived as they can seek judicial review.
Once class membership is established, individual plaintiffs use the Phase I findings to prove conduct elements.
